canonical.writer_model: single short writer transaction; no long cognition lock
canonical.identity: state_epoch + tx_id + root_hash + execution/lease epoch fence
canonical.history: append-only typed record versions + current-head projection
canonical.reentry: verified outcome + causal credit + admitted delta + provenance-bound reentry receipt

derived.vector_tensor: sidecar until target benchmark proves colocation superior

critical_read_rule: cognition-critical read either consumes projection with source_state_epoch meeting requirement or falls back/escalates; never silently mixes epochs
backup_rule: online backup/VACUUM INTO, never naive live .db copy in WAL mode
authority_rule: retrieval rank/activation/model output never mints truth or effect authority
